race.description: Laurel River @ Woodside Park F&M Mdn Plate
race.comment: CADDINGTON (11) resumes having run well in a handy 2yo race on debut at Sandown Hillside behind Divine Dot, getting home well for fourth in an encouraging effort. She looked good winning a recent trial and looks nicely placed this time around. CELESTIAL RULER (3) is off a very long spell, now with the Stokes yard. She was hard in the market on debut but pulled up with excuses. She's won a recent jumpout, watch the late betting for the new yard. INCOHERENT (6) is a mare by Omaha Beach on debut for the Hayes yard. She won a recent jumpout and looks a live hope with Ben Allen in the saddle. FLIGHT DU JOUR (5) can run well on debut, watch the betting.
